tasks.name: החצי הראשון
tasks.note: Keeps the first half of the list, with the middle element included when the length is odd.

tasks.name: המקסימום לראש
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const m=Math.max(...l); return [m,...l.filter(x=>x!==m)]; }
tasks.note: Pin-to-top: moves the largest element to the front and keeps the others in their original order.

tasks.name: החלפת הקצוות
tasks.note: Swaps the first and last elements while the middle stays in place.

tasks.name: החלפת זוגות סמוכים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let i=0;i+1<r.length;i+=2){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Pairwise swap: exchanges positions 0/1, 2/3, 4/5, ...; a trailing odd element stays put.

tasks.name: היפוך כל חצי
tasks.note: Splits at floor(n/2) and reverses each half separately (the longer half is the second one).

tasks.name: אי-זוגיים ואז זוגיים, ממוינים
tasks.note: Partition by parity with odds first, each group sorted ascending (house numbers: odd side, then even side).

tasks.name: הקרוב ל-12 קודם
tasks.note: Nearest-to-target ordering: sorts by distance from 12, ties broken by the smaller value first.

tasks.name: שזירת חצאים
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=Math.ceil(l.length/2), a=l.slice(0,h), b=l.slice(h), r=[]; for(let i=0;i<h;i++){ r.push(a[i]); if(i<b.length) r.push(b[i]); } return r; }
tasks.note: Perfect riffle shuffle: splits at ceil(n/2) and alternates first-half and second-half elements.

tasks.name: מיון יציב לפי שארית 3
tasks.note: Stable sort by the derived key x%3: groups 0,1,2 in order, equal keys keep their original relative order.

tasks.name: מיון לפי XOR 5
tasks.note: Sorts by the bitwise key x XOR 5, giving the fixed order 13,12,15,14,9,8,11,10.

tasks.name: מיון יורד, הגדול לסוף
tasks.note: Two steps: sorts descending, then rotates left by one so the maximum ends up last.

tasks.name: מיון הזוגיים במקומם
tasks.src: l=>{ const e=l.filter(x=>x%2===0).sort((a,b)=>a-b); let k=0; return l.map(x=>x%2===0?e[k++]:x); }
tasks.note: In-place partial sort: the even elements are sorted ascending among the even slots while odd elements keep their positions.
